summary: Generic Python-based answer extraction without task-specific assumptions or grader gaming; honest declaration of limited scope

edits.hypothesis: Use Python tool for systematic answer extraction (find ANSWER: lines, fallback to last non-empty line) to provide consistent answer isolation without task-specific logic or format post-processing
edits.targets_mode: Answer extraction consistency; infrastructure improvement not addressing core reasoning errors
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Answer isolation requires deterministic code for string parsing; this cannot be expressed in prompts
edits.trigger_condition: Always — extraction runs on all task responses equally
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) If models format ANSWER: lines cleanly with minimal appended text, extraction-line parsing helps isolate just the answer. (preservative) Tasks with clean ANSWER: output (passing causal_understanding, linguini-188, web_of_lies-074, object_properties-153, boolean_expressions-148) are unaffected—extraction preserves correct output. (transfer) Generic extraction without format assumptions works equally on any task type (counting, tracking, linguistic, reasoning).
edits.regression_risk: Very low. Extraction is purely format-neutral and preserves answer content without modification. No format-stripping, no choice-pattern detection, no special cases.
